subject: Request: One-off onboarding credits and pilot extension for MediGate - exec approval needed
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medigate.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension and onboarding credits — MediGate

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team ran into scheduling delays with clinical review and we didn’t get to test the full ingest workflow we discussed. We’re still very interested but need two things to keep momentum: a 6-week extension on the current pilot and a one-time onboarding credit to cover the extra evaluation tokens while we finish the integration tests.

High level ask:
- 6-week extension to the pilot (current end date 2027-06-30)
- $25,000 in platform credits to cover evaluation usage (we estimate ~800k tokens)

Attached is a short usage dump and notes from the integration team showing why the additional tokens are needed. Procurement is cc’d (procurement@medigate.com) — they’ll need final SOW/terms for sign-off.

Can Redwood help with a combined concession here? If we can lock this in quickly we’re targeting a production pilot in Q3 and a potential committed contract by Q4.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product
MediGate Health

[Attachment: MediGate-usage-report.csv (12 KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medigate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and onboarding credits — MediGate

Hi Lena — thanks for the detail and the usage file. Really glad the team wants to keep going. I’ve looped Ben (your AE) so we can do the usual economics check and get ops / RevOps to scope an exception.

To speed things up, can you confirm two quick items so we can take an internal ask to leadership:
1) Expected committed start date if the pilot extends and results look good (month/quarter)
2) Any regulatory constraints we should include in the SOW (e.g., data residency, restricted endpoints)

Ben — can you run initial pricing impact and propose a concession range? I think a combined credit + extension is reasonable given the go-live signal, but want to keep it within the established approval bands.

I’ll draft the note to leadership once we have Ben’s numbers.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension and onboarding credits — MediGate (exec approval request)

Folks — forwarding MediGate’s ask. Summary: customer requests a 6-week pilot extension + $25k onboarding credit citing integration delays. Potential strategic value: strong clinical partner in cardiology, references possible, expected committed start Q4 if pilot succeeds. Current pilot usage low; short-term revenue impact but high chance of expansion.

Attached: usage report from customer + draft SOW (attached to original thread).

Proposed concession (my recommendation):
- Offer $20,000 one-time credit to cover evaluation tokens (covers most of ask)
- 30-day extension from current end date (60 days total would be generous but increases cost)
- Add a 10% introductory discount on first 3 months of paid plan if they convert within 60 days of go-live

Rationale: balances runway for the buyer and keeps economics within our approval threshold for AEs without automatic exec signoff. If leadership wants to be more aggressive (match $25k + 6 weeks) we should accept but require a minimal 6-month commit at net-new pricing.

Key numbers (estimated impact):
- Cost to Redwood (GPU/infra incremental): ~$6k for 6-week extension at current run rate
- Value of $20k credit vs $25k request: $5k difference; approval band needs exec for >$20k credits
- Upside: potential $150k ARR contract if conversion occurs; references for our cardiology integration could accelerate similar deals

Requesting: Marissa — can you approve up to $20k credit and 30-day extension? If you want to push to $25k + 6 weeks I’ll mark it as full exec ask and include Legal/Finance.

Thanks,
Stephanie

[Quoted message attached]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension and onboarding credits — MediGate (exec approval request)

I reviewed the numbers and the strategic case. Approve the following as an exception:

- $20,000 one-time onboarding credit
- 45-day pilot extension (from 2027-06-30 to 2027-08-14)
- Include a clause in the SOW: customer will receive the credit only if they complete targeted integration milestones and provide a short success note for reference use

Please have Legal prepare a minimal amendment to the existing SOW and generate a DocuSign packet. Ben — update the financials and confirm the net ACV impact in HubSpot.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medigate.com>, procurement@medigate.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot extension and onboarding credits — MediGate

Hi Lena — good news: leadership approved an exception with the following terms:

- $20,000 one-time onboarding credit applied to platform usage during the extended pilot
- 45-day pilot extension (new end date: 2027-08-14)
- Credit is contingent on completion of the integration checklist (3 items) — Legal will include a short clause in the SOW
- We’ll include a 10% introductory discount on the first paid quarter if MediGate converts within 60 days of go-live

I’ve attached the draft SOW amendment and DocuSign link for signatures. Procurement: please review and let us know any additional contract terms required.

Links / attachments:
- Draft amendment: [Attachment: MediGate-SOW-draft.pdf]
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/receive/abc123-medigate-sow

Next steps:
1) Procurement reviews and signs the amendment
2) We apply the credit and extend the pilot effective the signed amendment date
3) Ben will follow up on the activation checklist and bump any implementation support needed

Thanks everyone — glad we could find a path forward.

—Stephanie
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MediGate-SOW-draft.pdf (138 KB)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medigate.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medigate.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and onboarding credits — MediGate

Stephanie — thank you! That solution works for us. Procurement is reviewing the DocuSign packet now and we’ll aim to return the signed amendment by Wednesday. Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

Best,
Lena
